telemetry.interpretation: Whole-verifier context only. System CPU is interval utilization across logical CPUs including this benchmark; process cpu_core_percent is relative to one logical CPU and may exceed 100. The first CPU observation is excluded. Cumulative disk deltas cover only adjacent valid samples. PID/create_time changes, unavailable processes and counter resets are never bridged or filled with zero. Nominal 200ms polling includes acquisition and scheduling gaps; missing-periodic counts estimate skipped nominal slots. No per-query interpolation, process-specific slowdown causality, Ollama token speed or optimization claim follows. Observer work remains part of this measured environment.

interpretation.query_spread: Per-repeat row statistics compare distinct fixed queries within one cell.
interpretation.temporal_variation: Ranges and signed later-minus-earlier pairs compare the same query within its original cohort only.
interpretation.weighting: No population-weighted scenario is published. Each segment deliberately selects its eligible maximum and one remaining hash-selected query; these samples and the reused anchor are not a uniform sample of the cell or its tail.
interpretation.accounting: Rank contains vote SQL and is nested in verification. Core is same-row verification plus append excluding nested commit and direct budget writes. Component medians must not be added. Setup, tail, all chunk commits and budget totals are separate overlapping diagnostics, not extra disjoint costs.
interpretation.limits: Seven fixed identities in one engineering window provide no confidence interval, causal speedup, future latency guarantee or full-run runtime bound. Telemetry describes each whole repeat, not per-query or process-specific causation.
interpretation.tail_reinforcement: Six new tail queries and one unchanged V6/V18 anchor are separated by role, segment and selection reason. All three repeats are retained; prior anchor windows are descriptive temporal comparisons only.

historical_anchor_interpretation: The same V6/V18/V19 scientific identity in different machine windows; descriptive temporal differences only, not an optimization speedup estimate.
sampling_interpretation: Six deliberate tail identities: one maximum-neighbor and one fixed-hash remainder in each registered band. Roles and bands remain separate. No population-weighted tail, whole-cell, or all-grid runtime projection is authorized.
telemetry_interpretation: Read-only 200ms target background observations span each verifier including setup, queries, append and tail. Sampler scheduling/CPU overhead is part of the environment, not an additional timer to sum. Only repeat-level associations are available; no per-query attribution or Ollama causality is established.
